title: WHOLLY® Brand Unveils New Squeezable Guacamole and Avocado Products Nationwide
summary: The ready-to-eat guacamole and avocado brand introduces new 10-ounce squeeze format for greater convenience and versatility.
body_markdown:
[WHOLLY® brand](https://www.eatwholly.com/products/) , America’s No. 1 refrigerated guacamole brand*, today announced the nationwide debut of WHOLLY® Avocado Squeeze and WHOLLY® Guacamole Squeeze. Designed to meet consumer demand for greater convenience and versatility, the new 10-ounce squeeze format keeps guacamole and smashed avocado green for up to 10 days after opening, directly addressing everyday frustrations of browning guacamole and food waste.


The launch comes as modern shoppers are hungry for value and look for convenient, easy food options they can rely on throughout the week. According to Tastewise, use of the terms “convenient” and “easy” in food-related conversations is growing, up 3.2% and 10.2%, respectively, over the past year. Recent predictions from Mintel also point to “a newfound respect for resourcefulness,” inspiring a fresh look at cans, pouches and other long-life product formats by the end of the decade.


The squeeze format gives consumers control to squeeze only what they need, eliminating the pressure to finish an entire package at once. Made with 100% real Hass avocados, the new products are available in Mild, Spicy Jalapeño and Sea Salt. Each flavor is non-GMO, naturally gluten-free and free from artificial flavors and synthetic colors.


“We always strive to meet consumers where they are,” said Christopher Monahan, brand manager for the[WHOLLY® brand](https://www.hormelfoods.com/brand/wholly-guacamole-brand/) . “Our mission is to make real, delicious avocado products convenient for everyday use. We proudly use high-pressure processing (HPP) for all our innovations, and our new squeezable guacamole and avocado products are specifically designed for multi-use convenience, keeping guacamole green and maintaining fresh taste for up to 10 days after opening.”


## Frequently Asked Questions


#### Why did the WHOLLY® brand launch squeezable avocado and guacamole? How is it different from the existing lineup?


Whole avocados can be unpredictable and difficult to meal prep, as they’re often too ripe or not ripe enough. The brand’s new squeeze format builds on consumers’ love of avocados while offering greater versatility and convenience to the prepackaged dips and spreads category. The WHOLLY® brand is primarily known for its prepackaged guacamole, available in over five different flavors in both mini and bowl sizes, as well as smashed and diced avocados. The new squeeze format expands the ways consumers can use avocado products.


#### Where can I find WHOLLY® Avocado Squeeze and WHOLLY® Guacamole Squeeze? How much do they cost?


Each flavor of WHOLLY® Guacamole Squeeze and WHOLLY® Avocado Squeeze is available nationwide at Kroger-owned grocery stores and regional retailers including H-E-B, Piggly Wiggly, Winco and more. Suggested retail prices range from $4.49 to $5.99.


#### How can I use WHOLLY® squeezable guacamole and avocado products in my daily routine? What recipes should I try?


WHOLLY® Avocado Squeeze is a convenient alternative to whole avocados. Made with 100% Hass avocados, it is ready to enjoy without the prep. Use it for everyday favorites like avocado toast, breakfast sandwiches and wraps, or get creative by incorporating it into homemade sushi rolls, DIY guacamole, creamy dressings and more.


WHOLLY® Guacamole Squeeze, available in Mild and Spicy Jalapeño, are ready to enjoy whenever you’re craving a little extra flavor. It’s perfect for topping tacos, nachos and burrito bowls or adding a flavorful spread to burgers and sandwiches.


#### How can prepackaged avocado help me get more fiber in my day?


The broader WHOLLY® portfolio includes avocado and guacamole products in convenient 2-ounce mini sizes that are a good source of fiber. Each mini offers 3 grams of fiber per serving (11% Daily Value). For those spreading their fiber intake across the day, WHOLLY® products provide a seamless way of ‘fiberlayering’ (small boosts of fiber via snacks versus a large meal) without the mess of slicing and dicing or the tragedy of a brown avocado.
